title: Hindu Temple Burglarized in Sindh's Shikarpur District
excerpt: Unidentified thieves broke into the Maha Shakti Mata Temple in Sindh, stealing gold ornaments, cash, antiques, and artefacts.
body_html: Unidentified individuals broke into the Maha Shakti Mata Temple, located in Sindh's Shikarpur district. The perpetrators stole several items from the religious site, including gold ornaments, cash, antique items, and various artefacts.
